subject: Re: ACME SIG deep-dive — recording access & artifact logistics
messages:
From: Jake Morris <jmorris@acme-corp.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-08-22T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACME SIG deep-dive — timing and recording

Hi Nikhil,

Thanks for taking this on. We want to schedule a 60min SIG deep-dive next week to walk through the CAIQ and a few SOC 2 evidence examples. Two quick asks upfront:

- Will Redwood record the session and can we get access to the recording for internal review?
- We may need short-lived sample logs (anonymized) demonstrating retention/archival — what’s the best way to request that?

Available windows: Tue 8/24 10–12 PT or Wed 8/25 13–16 PT.

Appreciate confirmation and any pre-read you can share.

Thanks,
Jake Morris
Head of Security Operations
Acme Corp

From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>
To: Jake Morris <jmorris@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME SIG deep-dive — timing and recording

Hi Jake —

Thanks — we can do Tue 8/24 10:30–11:30 PT. Irene (SIG intake lead) and Marissa (engineering owner for logs) will join. Quick answers to your two asks:

1) Recording: Yes, we can record. We’ll publish the recording to a shared Drive link and set access to Acme-only for 90 days unless you request a different retention window. If you need us to disable recording, let us know but recording is handy for follow-ups.

2) Sample logs: We can provide anonymized log samples that demonstrate ingestion, retention labels, and the archival flow. To keep things tidy, we typically ship a CSV manifest describing included fields and a small tarball with redacted entries. We’ll ask for a brief MOU (one paragraph) that describes the intended use — purely for internal evaluation — and we’ll deliver via a secure Drive link or SFTP.

I’ll attach a short draft of our CAIQ answer plan and a sample logs request template for you to review before the call.

Proposed agenda (60m):
- 5m intro & objectives
- 20m CAIQ walk-through (areas you flagged)
- 20m logs & retention demo + Q&A
- 10m next steps & artifact handoff cadence

If 10:30–11:30 PT works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include the docs.

Best,
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Manager, Solutions Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sig-answers-draft.pdf, acme-sample-logs-request.csv

From: Lena Park <lena.park@acme-corp.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Jake Morris <jmorris@acme-corp.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-08-22T12:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME SIG deep-dive — timing and recording

Thanks — Tue 8/24 10:30–11:30 PT is fine. A couple of clarifications for the sample logs:

- We only need a few representative indices and redacted PII — the CSV manifest format you mentioned sounds good.
- For the MOU, can you point to a template? Legal will want that to be lightweight.
- For retention on the recording: 90 days is acceptable. Can we request a simple note in the Drive that records the date and retention period?

Looking forward to the call.

Lena Park
Director, InfoSec Engineering
Acme Corp

From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Lena Park <lena.park@acme-corp.com>, Jake Morris <jmorris@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-22T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME SIG deep-dive — recording access & artifact logistics

Hi Lena/Jake —

Great — calendar invite sent for Tue 8/24 10:30–11:30 PT (zoom link included). We’ll record and publish the recording to a Drive folder with an access notice that lists the 90-day retention and the delivery date. I’ve attached the draft CAIQ answer plan Nikhil referenced and a sample logs request template — both are short.

On the MOU: we have a one-paragraph template that we use for log samples. I’ve pasted it below for quick review — if legal needs to iterate we can exchange via redlines but 99% of customers accept it as-is.

--- MOU (sample) ---
Redwood Inference will provide anonymized, redacted log samples to Acme Corp solely for the purpose of internal security evaluation. Acme Corp agrees not to redistribute the samples outside of its internal security and engineering teams and to delete the artifacts within 30 days of receiving them unless otherwise agreed in writing.

If that looks fine I’ll include the MOU text in the Drive manifest.

Also answering a common question: our standard sample logs include: event timestamp, anonymized user_id, request_path, response_code, retention_label, and storage_tier. We do not include raw PII; anything that could be sensitive is redacted.

See you on Tue.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Principal, Trust & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sig-answers-draft.pdf, acme-sample-logs-request.csv

From: Jake Morris <jmorris@acme-corp.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@acme-corp.com>, security@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-08-24T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME SIG deep-dive — recording access & artifact logistics

All set — we reviewed the MOU template and it’s fine from our side. Recording and 90-day retention is okay; please include a short metadata note in the Drive (date delivered + retention).

Two quick requests before we meet tomorrow:
1) Can you add a 1–2 slide summary that maps the CAIQ sections we’ll cover to the Redwood owners (e.g., "networking — Marissa; identity — Nikhil")?
2) Please drop the Drive folder link and the DocuSign envelope for the MOU (if you prefer e-sign) so legal can expedite.

Thanks — see you on the call.

Jake
